diagnosis: The decentralized storage deletion endpoint accepts an IPFS CID parameter and instructs Pinata to unpin the content. It does not verify whether the requesting user's tenant account originally pinned this CID in the application's internal database registry. An authenticated user can supply CIDs belonging to other tenants, forcing them to be unpinned and garbage-collected from decentralized storage nodes.
